message.content: I don’t have live access to current air‑quality data, so I can’t tell you the exact AQI for Los Angeles at this moment. Typically, LA’s air quality varies from “good” (AQI 0–50) to “moderate” (51–100) depending on traffic, weather, and wildfire smoke. For the most up‑to‑date reading, check a reliable source such as the AirNow website, the EPA’s Air Quality Index app, or a local news outlet’s weather section.
